title: UHC Denying all claims as OON but Provider is IN network

posts.text:
I own a small medical billing company. I have providers in all different specialties. Since the beginning of 2025, I have had many UHC claims come back and processed as out of network for multiple clients but these providers are all in network. I have uploaded information show their network status, have spoken with multiple reps with UHC provider relations who all confirm the providers are in network, and every time something comes back it is denied stating they are out of network. I have run into a road block with them and am at a loss for how to proceed to get these claims paid.
Provider specialties I am seeing it with currently are: BH counseling (LPC and LCSW), Psych Med Management (APRN, NP), and Primary care (NP and MD). Not all of the claims are being denied, some UHC claims process and others don't. I have been told it's the patient's plan but they have the same "plan" as others being processed as in network and have been told numerous times by UHC provider relations that the "plan" is in network with each of my providers.
If anyone else has experienced this and has a solution please reach out! I don't know where to go from here. Thanks!!
File a complaint to your state insurance commissioners office. They will contact them and that usually will take care of things.

dstruve said:

I am sorry you guys are having issues as well, although it does make me feel better knowing I am not the only one.

Hello,
We are having this same issue. We have a ton a claims for Medicare advantage UHC where a patients claims are processing completely fine and then those same patients with the same providers are randomly processing out of network. We have been fighting with UHC for a long time now and not getting any resolution. So far we have been in contact with our contract manager and the senior provider Relations advocate. They advised it was a contracting issue, so we recontracted with them and the issue is still not fixed. Now they are telling us that they cant resolve this issue. Have you had any luck with getting this resolved?
